correctness.rationale: The path modes λ_j=2−2cos(πj/n) and rail modes 0,r,3r diagonalize L. A single scalar input reaches one dimension per distinct eigenvalue with nonzero local projection (PBH/Vandermonde), with (g−1)/2 zero longitudinal modes g=gcd(n,2s−1) odd. For rational r, a positive difference of distinct λ_i is a rational algebraic integer in (0,4), hence one of 1,2,3. The primitive-root conjugate arc argument classifies the only pairs at these gaps, including the two golden-ratio pairs for d=1 at 5|n; branch overlaps occur only at 1,3/2,2,3. Inclusion-exclusion of those pairs and one triple eigenvalue at n divisible by six yields the stated outer- and middle-rail formulas, with correct endpoint n=2 and unit-weight mod-five cases. Independently built modular Krylov matrices from weighted graph adjacency gave 792 rank equalities n=2..9, all single input vertices, and six rational weights. Finite Krylov checks corroborate; primitive-root gap classification proves all n.
